hash_definition: SHA-256 of exact file bytes, including the final LF newline.
delivery_policy: Deliver the prompt file verbatim; metadata and evaluator files are not prompt content.
versioning_policy: Keep wording in Git; any byte change requires new hashes and a new prompt-set version. Record version and hash with every run.

origin_definitions.tp_methodology: The activity and requirements come directly from TP section 3.2; wording_relation specifies whether the actual text is normalized or newly phrased.
origin_definitions.tp_with_benchmark_extensions: A TP activity with extra benchmark-specific requirements explicitly listed in benchmark_extensions.

execution_notes: The three word-frequency variants are alternatives for independent comparisons, not mandatory consecutive edits. Start each from the same declared snapshot.
Generate-tests follows a declared word-frequency implementation/specification; the full oracle applies only to the explicit variant.
Optimization is intentionally underspecified. Assess assumptions and behavior preservation; do not add hidden performance requirements.
Apply native undo after optimization as a workflow command, not an ordinary inference prompt.
Temperature comparisons must use identical starting snapshots and exact prompt bytes.
